description:
This audit-focused software archive provides the clinical-safety evaluation materials used in the manuscript Lower Point Error Does Not Imply Clinical Safety: Re-evaluating CGM Forecasting through Event Prediction and Cross-Population Generalization.

The repository supports independent audit of the study's three core contributions: (1) multidimensional clinical-risk evaluation that integrates DTS risk zones, missed-event rates, alarm burden, and lead time with conventional MAE/RMSE; (2) direct event classification with matched-specificity comparison; and (3) CGM-only external transfer with fixed source-selected thresholds to Chinese T1D/T2DM cohorts.

Included materials

  • DTS Error Grid implementation with boundary tests for the Diabetes Technology Society point-accuracy risk zones
  • Clinical-safety metrics for binary events, discrimination (PR-AUC/ROC-AUC), false-alarm episode counting, and lead-time summarization
  • Trajectory-derived risk scoring based on the negative predicted minimum glucose
  • Matched-specificity operating-point selection and fixed-threshold external-transfer evaluation
  • Privacy-preserving aggregate result tables corresponding to manuscript Tables 2–6
  • Automated consistency tests and a reconstruction script for principal Markdown tables and aggregate-data figures
  • Documentation for data sources, privacy/licensing boundaries, and manuscript-output mapping

Repository layout

  • src/cgm_safety/: auditable metric implementations
  • derived/: structured aggregate values used in the manuscript
  • scripts/: deterministic table and figure reconstruction
  • tests/: DTS boundaries, metric behavior, and manuscript-number checks
  • docs/: data provenance, privacy/licensing, and manuscript-output mapping

Install and verify

conda env create -f environment.yml
conda activate cgm-safety-audit
python -m pip install -e .
pytest
python scripts/build_paper_outputs.py

Generated tables and figures are written to output/.

Data and privacy boundary

The public CGM datasets analyzed in the study are available from their original sources cited in the manuscript. This deposit archives evaluation code, DTS Error Grid implementation, aggregate result tables, tests, and reconstruction scripts. Raw CGM records and individual-level prediction outputs remain governed by the original data providers' access and redistribution terms. Details are provided in docs/PRIVACY_AND_LICENSE.md and docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.

Citation

Please cite this software archive using the Zenodo DOI for the version used, and cite the accompanying manuscript when referring to the scientific findings. Citation metadata are also provided in CITATION.cff.
